title: Counterexamples to the duality conjecture for metric entropy
summary: We disprove Pietsch's dimension-free duality conjecture for metric entropy. For every proposed pair of universal constants, we construct origin-symmetric convex bodies that violate the corresponding covering-entropy inequality, already when the covering body is a cube.

review.reason: Constructs convex bodies that disprove Pietsch's dimension-free duality conjecture for metric entropy.
